translation: Took place in posad Serock, 28 June 1890, 7 AM. Appeared personally Moszek Cukier, carter, 34, and Herszek Konikol[?], carter, 25, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that on 26 June of the current year at 8 PM died in posad Serock a child of female[?] sex, without a name, aged twenty-four hours, son[sic] of Chaim Jankiel Zacharek and his wife Grina[?] nee Graf, residing in posad Serock. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us; the witnesses are illiterate.
